utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: The repair drive? Oh, right, the playground thing... I think I saw something about it. What's the plan again?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, we're meeting this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center to fix the playground and other things around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, Saturday at 10 AM? Alright, I'll try to be there. Just remind me again if I forget.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Opal, are you interested in helping with the tool repair drive next Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, yes! I've been tracking their progress—they're at the northwest corner now. I'd be happy to help on Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Opal! We could use your help sorting tools. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can take a look at your toaster, Tess! I'm pretty handy with small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey, are we still on for the repair drive Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, Bo! I'll be there at 10 AM. Can't wait to see everyone and fix up some things!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can check the bulletin board later, want me to grab a flyer for you?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that'd be great, Ira. I really need to know the time so I can bring my blender.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I'll grab a flyer and let you know what time it starts.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Kira, we're gathering supplies for the repair drive. Do you have any tools or materials to contribute?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure that's the official repair drive? I heard there might be some scheduling mix-ups.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, I think it's the right one—I saw the sign-up sheet on the community board yesterday. Let me double-check to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Gus, are you planning to go to the repair drive this Saturday? I'm thinking of bringing my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Tess! I'll bring my toolbox and we can take a look at that toaster together.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That's great, Gus! My toaster's been acting up—the toast keeps burning on one side. Maybe you can figure it out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Sam! Are you planning to help out with the repair drive this Saturday? We're starting at 9 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I'll be there! I've already told Mara I'd help fix some tools, so I'm ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That's wonderful, Sam! I'm glad you and Mara are on board. Looking forward to working with you both.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, Pia. Do we have a fixed time for the repair drive yet? I'd like to mark it on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Not yet, Eli—I'm still checking the schedule to find a good time. What works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Mornings are best for me, Pia. I'm usually free from 9 to 12.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, sorry, what repair drive are we talking about again?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The repair drive for the playground equipment. We're meeting at the park on Saturday at 9 to fix things up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Wait, I thought it was for tools? Are we doing the playground too? I'm all mixed up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Do you know if the repair drive will finally fix that leaky fountain at the park?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I've heard bits about it, but not sure about the fountain specifically. Did someone mention that?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, Faye told me the park repairs are part of it, but Pia said the schedule isn't confirmed yet.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, sorting help would be great. Bring boxes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I'm on it! I'll spread the word at the park and bring along some boxes too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, I'll stop by the grocery store bulletin board later.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, that's great! Just a heads-up, the repair drive has been moved to Sunday instead of Saturday, still at the community center. Let folks know the new date!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sunday? That works better for me anyway. Do you know the time still the same?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: It's a repair drive to fix broken items like my blender. Still hoping to get the time sorted out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'd be happy to take a look at your blender, Dane. Maybe we can set a time this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That would be great, Sam! What time on Saturday works for you?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure the repair drive is happening today? I thought the schedule was still up in the air.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, it's definitely today! I've been tracking it—Saturday from 9 to 3 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: But did you check with Pia about the traffic? She mentioned it could be a problem if we pick a busy time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Jules, what do I need to do to get involved?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great to have you on board! Just show up at the community center this Saturday at 10 AM. And if you have any broken items, bring them along – Tess is already bringing her toaster!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Should I bring any tools, or just my broken items?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Leo, are you free to help with the tool repair drive next Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, I can help. 9 AM at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks Leo! See you then.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, the repair drive? I've heard a bit about it from others. What's it all about?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: It's a neighborhood event where we fix things together, but I'm still checking the schedule and tool availability to make sure it runs smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds really helpful! Do you need any help sorting through the supplies?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Uh, sorry Mara, I'm actually already committed to the playground repair drive on Saturday. Same thing?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, the playground repair drive at the park, 9 o'clock.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Good, glad we're all on the same page. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good! I'll bring a few basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I'll make sure to have my wrench set ready too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Perfect, I think between us we'll have most things covered. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Cleo! Are you planning to join the repair drive this Saturday? We're starting at 9 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, I'll definitely be there! I've been gathering a list of needed supplies from folks—want to make sure we're all set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That's wonderful, Cleo! Let me know if you need any help with the supplies or if there's anything I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rosa, are you planning to come to the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Tess, thanks for asking! Actually, the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center, from 9 to 3. Hope you can still come!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Sunday works even better for me! I'll still bring my toaster.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I heard they could use more volunteers on Saturday. You can sign up at the community center or check the bulletin board.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh good, I need to bring my old hammer. But wait, is that the same drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, it's the same one—this Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hi Rey! I'm off to the park to rally some volunteers for the repair drive this Saturday—want to join me?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I guess I could come along. Are they finally going to fix that leaky fountain at the park?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I'm not sure about the fountain specifically, but the drive is for general repairs, so let's go ask!
